mapping.OpenEdition Books License: exclude: not CC BY/BY-SA/PD (licence terms not verified)
mapping.GNU General Public License: exclude: GPL is not CC BY/BY-SA/PD (outside selection rule)

licence.manual_annotation_rule: sentences with analysis="manual" in texts whose TREEBANK_ANNOTATIONS project is NC (PROIEL, Gorman) are dropped

selection_rules.rule: candidate if GENRE_STANDARD == 'Lyric poetry' OR AUTHOR_STANDARD in the Melos list; kept only if SOURCE_LICENSE maps to open

excluded_candidates.reason: exclude: not CC BY/BY-SA/PD (licence terms not verified)

coverage_vs_forms_jsonl.note: exact = NFC equality; elision_folded maps U+2019/U+0027/U+02BC to U+1FBD. Tokens without letters excluded.
